color-brand-50.$description: Brand tint. Selected-row tint in light (state-selected-tint). Components never name ramp steps; use a role (lint L-2).

color-brand-200.$description: Brand tint step. Components never name ramp steps; use a role (lint L-2).

color-brand-300.$description: Brand accent on forest chrome (8.9:1 on accent-950, see contrast ledger). Components never name ramp steps; use a role (lint L-2).

color-brand-400.$description: Brand text/border in dark theme; dark focus ring; PRESSED CTA fill in both themes (lighter, not darker: dark ink stays 5.58:1). Components never name ramp steps; use a role (lint L-2).

color-brand-500.$description: Action base: primary CTA fill. Label on it is text-on-brand = accent-800 dark ink (4.63:1, AA). The orange is fixed. Components never name ramp steps; use a role (lint L-2).

color-brand-800.$description: Brand text on light, high contrast. Components never name ramp steps; use a role (lint L-2).

color-brand-900.$description: Brand dark step. Components never name ramp steps; use a role (lint L-2).

color-accent-100.$description: Forest tint step. Components never name ramp steps; use a role (lint L-2).

color-accent-200.$description: Forest light step. Dark-mode marketing ink (mk-ink). Components never name ramp steps; use a role (lint L-2).

color-halal-certified-seal.$description: CERTIFIED seal fill, light. The ONLY filled solid green surface in the system (RULE H-1). Brighter than forest chrome so 'verified' is never mistaken for chrome. A state is a composite {fill, ring, shield, label}, never a bare colour (H-2). RESERVED halal namespace: only HalalBadge, HalalCertificationPanel, HalalChecklist and HalalShield may read it (invariant 10, lint L-4).

color-map-route-active.$description: Active route: 5px stroke with a 2px white casing.

color-map-pin-rider.$description: Rider pin. Owner decision (T-23): forest chrome, NOT the halal seal green, so the green-solid monopoly (invariant 10) has no exception. Same colour as the customer pin: tell them apart by glyph, never by colour alone. No shield glyph.

surface-base.$description: App background: warm cream / near-black canvas. Also control-bg.

surface-sunken.$description: Wells and inset areas below the canvas.

surface-subtle.$description: Quiet panels; dark elevation 1-2 surface step.

surface-raised.$description: Cards. In dark, elevation is this SURFACE STEP, not a shadow (black on near-black is invisible).

surface-chrome.$description: Forest chrome: operational/field app bars (restaurant, admin, rider).

text-tertiary.$description: Timestamps, meta. AA-large; never the sole critical label.

text-placeholder.$description: Placeholder only, never the sole label.

text-secondary-field.$description: RIDER / field theme secondary text. The rider app requires >=7:1 for ALL body text (04-accessibility.md, sunlight legibility); plain text-secondary is only 5.78:1 on dark surface-raised. Measured >=7:1 on every light and dark rider surface (see contrast ledger). Use on rider surfaces only; other apps keep text-secondary for hierarchy.

text-disabled.$description: Disabled text. WCAG 1.4.3 exempts disabled controls; also signalled by state-disabled-opacity + aria-disabled.

text-on-brand.$description: Label on the orange CTA (brand-500): dark forest ink #0F241C, 4.63:1 AA in both themes (the fill is brand-500 in both). Was white at 3.52:1; reversed Sep 2026 on the client's instruction. The only permitted label colour on the brand fill.

text-on-accent.$description: Text on forest chrome / secondary button.

text-link-hover.$description: Link hover. Themed so the dark hover stays readable (the raw info-700 measured 1.93:1 on the dark page).

border-decorative.$description: Dividers. Decorative only: never bounds an interactive control. Dark: also the elevation 3-4 hairline.

border-strong.$description: Emphasised borders; control hover border; switch track off.

focus-ring.$description: The theme's focus colour (= border-brand; docs/decisions/focus-indicator.md). Bordered fields: the field's own 2px border in this colour, no ring. Borderless controls: 2px focus-offset layer + 3px ring, flipping to focus-ring-on-* on coloured containers.

focus-offset.$description: 2px offset layer in the page colour, between the control and the ring.

focus-on-color.$description: Generic flip colour for the ring on coloured containers where focus-ring < 3:1. Prefer the specific focus-ring-on-* token.

focus-ring-on-accent.$description: Ring on a forest (accent-600) container. Dark keeps the orange ring (it clears 3:1 there).

state-hover-overlay.$description: Hover overlay laid over any fill.

state-pressed-overlay.$description: Pressed overlay laid over any fill.

action-primary-bg.$description: Primary CTA fill (orange). Action is orange, never green.

action-primary-bg-pressed.$description: Pressed CTA: LIGHTER (brand-400), not darker. No label clears 4.5:1 on brand-600; dark ink on brand-400 is 5.58:1.

action-danger-bg.$description: Destructive button fill. Never used by any halal state.

action-primary.$description: DEPRECATED alias of action-primary-bg (renamed to match the repo role map). Kept so existing components resolve; migrate and remove.

action-primary-pressed.$description: DEPRECATED alias of action-primary-bg-pressed. Migrate and remove.

action-secondary.$description: DEPRECATED alias of action-secondary-bg. Migrate and remove.

action-secondary-pressed.$description: DEPRECATED alias of action-secondary-bg-pressed. Migrate and remove.

action-track-on.$description: DEPRECATED alias of control-track-on. Migrate and remove.

feedback-success-tint.$description: Success banner/inline tint. Tint-only: there is NO feedback-success-solid (RULE H-1).

feedback-danger-solid.$description: Solid danger fill (badges, toasts). Never for a halal state.

elev-surface-1.$description: Surface for elevation 1. Dark themes ignore shadow and step the surface (surface-subtle).

elev-surface-3.$description: Surface for elevation 3 (dark: surface-raised step + elev-hairline).

elev-surface-4.$description: Surface for elevation 4 (dark: surface-raised step + elev-hairline).

elev-surface-sticky.$description: Surface for sticky bars (dark: surface-raised step).

elev-hairline.$description: 1px hairline for elevation 3-4 in DARK only (= border-decorative dark); transparent in light, where the shadow carries the lift.

mk-ink.$description: Marketing site only (halalgoes.com): body ink. Light 11.72:1 on cream; dark 8.04:1 on #171717. Product apps use text-* roles.

mk-wordmark.$description: Marketing site only: the wordmark. Dark #D0D0D1 is the colour of the supplied reversed lockup, carried across, not re-picked.

mk-accent.$description: Marketing site only: underline / arrow accent (non-text).

mk-seal.$description: Marketing site seal field. Aliases the halal namespace so the site can never advertise a different seal from the app.

mk-on-seal.$description: Marketing site: glyph/label on the seal.

mk-expired-bg.$description: Marketing site EXPIRED sample: cool slate, never red.

elev-surface-sticky.$description: Surface for sticky bars (dark: surface-raised step).

elev-hairline.$description: 1px hairline for elevation 3-4 in DARK only (= border-decorative dark); transparent in light, where the shadow carries the lift.

mk-ink.$description: Marketing site only (halalgoes.com): body ink. Light 11.72:1 on cream; dark 8.04:1 on #171717. Product apps use text-* roles.

mk-wordmark.$description: Marketing site only: the wordmark. Dark #D0D0D1 is the colour of the supplied reversed lockup, carried across, not re-picked.

mk-accent.$description: Marketing site only: underline / arrow accent (non-text).

mk-seal.$description: Marketing site seal field. Aliases the halal namespace so the site can never advertise a different seal from the app.

mk-on-seal.$description: Marketing site: glyph/label on the seal.

mk-expired-bg.$description: Marketing site EXPIRED sample: cool slate, never red.

mk-expired-fg.$description: Label on mk-expired-bg. INVERTS in dark: white on #7C8794 fails (3.65:1), #171717 is 4.91:1.

space-section.$description: halalgoes.com gap between page sections, desktop (= space-24; the site's lg:mt-24). Marketing only.

space-section-phone.$description: halalgoes.com gap between page sections, phone (= space-16; the site's mt-16). Marketing only.

density-row-height.$description: ACTIVE list-row height. Components read density-*; they never hard-code. Default here is comfortable (customer app); bundle.css swaps it per [data-hg-density] / [data-density].

density-card-padding.$description: ACTIVE card padding (comfortable default; swapped per density).

density-gutter.$description: ACTIVE gutter (comfortable default; swapped per density).

density-comfortable-row-height.$description: Comfortable density (customer app; admin web): row height.

density-compact-row-height.$description: Compact density (restaurant web, admin tables; the repo's web :root default): row height.

density-roomy-row-height.$description: Roomy density (rider app: gloved thumb, one hand): row height.

target-min.$description: Minimum hit area everywhere (WCAG 2.2 / Apple HIG).

target-field.$description: Rider app minimum target: gloved thumb, one-handed.

target-critical-field.$description: Rider Accept/Decline, restaurant Accept order: irreversible actions under time pressure.

focus-ring-width.$description: Width of the focus ring on borderless controls.

focus-offset-width.$description: Width of the page-coloured offset layer between control and ring.

focus-field-border-width.$description: A focused bordered field (Input, Textarea, Select) shows its own border at this width in focus-ring; no ring.

breakpoint-sm.$description: Web only. RN apps use density, not breakpoints.

breakpoint-lg.$description: Web only. Restaurant queue switches to 4 columns at/above this.

breakpoint-xl.$description: Web only. Marketing desktop layout width.

radius-xs.$description: Tiny: checkbox, focus outline radius on the marketing site.

radius-md.$description: Default. Also the halal seal: a softly squared plate reads as a seal; radius-full would read as a tag.

radius-xl.$description: Large cards; the marketing site's default card radius (rounded-xl).

radius-full.$description: Pills, avatars, marketing pill chips. Never the halal seal.

elev-1.$description: Elevation 1 (cards at rest). DARK: no shadow; use elev-surface-1 (surface-subtle step).

elev-2.$description: Elevation 2 (hovered cards, menus). DARK: no shadow; use elev-surface-2 (surface-subtle step).

elev-3.$description: Elevation 3 (sheets, dropdowns). DARK: no shadow; use elev-surface-3 (surface-raised step) + 1px elev-hairline.

elev-4.$description: Elevation 4 (dialogs). DARK: no shadow; use elev-surface-4 (surface-raised step) + 1px elev-hairline.

elev-sticky.$description: Floating cart bar, sticky checkout footer: shadow points UP. DARK: no shadow; use elev-surface-sticky.

duration-deliberate.$description: StatusTimeline step advance; halal seal first reveal. 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion. Reduced motion collapses durations only; there is no cross-fade fallback.

ease-linear.$description: COUNTDOWNS AND PROGRESS ONLY: easing a deadline misrepresents remaining time.

ease-spring.$description: MARKETING SURFACE ONLY. Slight overshoot for micro-interactions; transform and opacity only, never layout. Pair with duration-base or duration-moderate.

spring-snappy.$description: RN spring (Reanimated): quick settle. Descriptive, not a CSS value.

spring-smooth.$description: RN spring: default. Descriptive, not a CSS value.

spring-gentle.$description: RN spring: slow, soft settle. Descriptive, not a CSS value.

state-disabled-opacity.$description: Disabled control opacity: .6 light, .5 DARK. This format cannot theme a non-colour token, so the dark .5 is set in components/bundle.css under [data-theme="dark"]. Always paired with aria-disabled.

numeric-tabular.$description: MANDATORY on Price, Countdown, StatusTimeline, DataTable, Rating (font-variant-numeric).

icon-stroke-default.$description: Icon stroke width (Solar/Lucide product icons). The halal shield is bespoke, never an icon-font glyph.

z-offer-sheet.$description: Rider offer sheet outranks everything; non-dismissible until the server expires_at.

separation-certified-seal-vs-success-600.$description: Separation (must be told apart, not fg/bg): color-halal-certified-seal #0F7A43 vs color-success-600 #067A55 measures 1.01:1. CANNOT separate by luminance. Separation is by FORM: the seal is the only filled solid green (RULE H-1, lint L-4); success is tint-only. The repo ledger's 1.3 is stale (T-25).

separation-certified-tint-vs-success-50.$description: Separation (must be told apart, not fg/bg): color-halal-certified-tint #E9F3E4 vs color-success-50 #E9F3E4 measures 1.00:1. Identical by design (#E9F3E4). Success tints never carry a shield and never appear inside HalalCertificationPanel.

separation-brand-500-vs-warning-600.$description: Separation (must be told apart, not fg/bg): color-brand-500 #F1521E vs color-warning-600 #B84A08 measures 1.48:1. CAUTION: both orange. Separated by ROLE: brand is a filled CTA, warning is icon + text under a warning glyph, never a large fill.

type-display-lg.$description: Rider offer earnings; admin hero metric.

type-body-md.$description: Default body (also the base element style).

type-body-sm.$description: Floor for any text a customer must read to decide.

type-label-sm.$description: Badge and seal label. 'Halal certified' is sentence case, NEVER all-caps (screen readers may spell it out).

type-caption.$description: Timestamps; the standing line 'Certification verified by Halal Goes on {date}. Halal Goes does not itself certify food.'

type-mono-md.$description: IDs, UUIDv7, certificate numbers, audit payloads. IBM Plex Mono disambiguates 1/l/I and 0/O where Plus Jakarta Sans does not.

type-mono-sm.$description: Small mono: table IDs, certificate numbers in dense rows.

type-marketing-hero.$description: halalgoes.com hero, desktop. Marketing surface only, never in the apps. Nothing else on the site is set at this size.

type-marketing-hero-phone.$description: halalgoes.com hero, phone. HEAVIER than desktop on purpose: Bricolage's optical-size axis makes the larger size need less weight.

type-marketing-lede.$description: halalgoes.com standfirst under a head, desktop: display face at a text weight.

type-marketing-eyebrow.$description: halalgoes.com tracked chip above a head, desktop. Set UPPERCASE; the site sets it in the mono face on most sections (the launch chip uses the UI face).
